background_story: Jace was a charming young man with a bonnily disposition that could light up a room. Growing up in a small Scottish village, he was known for his warm smile and infectious laughter. Jace had a way of making everyone feel welcome, whether it was at the local pub or at his family's cozy bed-and-breakfast. His bonnily nature made him a favorite among the villagers, who would often gather 'round to hear his tales of adventure and bravery. As a talented musician, Jace would often play his guitar and sing traditional Scottish songs, his voice as smooth as honey. His kind heart and gentle spirit drew people to him, and he became a beloved fixture in the community, spreading joy and warmth wherever he went.
